description: review-only real-model catalog for activity-evidence-v3. Three tasks use different real files and force a two-read sequence (read A -> result -> short public progress -> read B), so acceptance can prove result-to-next-call continuity, not just a filename. No mock.tools and no scripted upstream. The third task drafts a local email reply from seeded inbox material; it never sends mail.

scenarios.title: check PR 174 against main with two reads
scenarios.description: First read returns PR 174 notes; the model must write one short public progress sentence before reading main. Objects: #174, conflict count.

files.pr/174-notes.md:
# PR 174

conflict files: 3
files: BotChatModel.swift, BotRuntimePresentation.swift, BotActivityPhrases.swift
files.pr/main-notes.md:
# main

base commit: 908d582b
PR 174 touches three files; merge check still open.

turns.prompt: 查一下 #174 能不能合：先读 pr/174-notes.md，再读 pr/main-notes.md。每读完一个文件，先用一句 10–20 字的简短进度说明刚看到什么、下一步看什么，再继续；最后只回答冲突文件数。

scenarios.title: summarize Wednesday meeting from two real files
scenarios.description: Same two-read sequence with different objects (meeting, owner) so the bubble sentences must differ from ACT-01. Tool choice is recorded from the real session log, not forced by the catalog: read or a bash call carrying the file path both count as real tool use.

scenarios.title: draft a local reply to Li Guanghao from seeded inbox material
scenarios.description: Reads a local inbox message and context, then drafts a reply. No mail account, network or send tool is used; only a local draft is produced. Tool choice is recorded from the real session log, not forced by the catalog: read or a bash call carrying the file path both count as real tool use.
